description:
The compiler emits 126 distinct `defk_`/`DEFK_` tokens, 94 of them header symbols; `priv/defk_runtime.h` (2,444 lines; the compiler map says ~1,900) holds 98 defines and 146 static functions with nothing separating the symbols the compiler calls from the ~150 internal ones. The interface must be learned from compiler.ex's emit strings.

Settled shape (grilling 2026-10-19):
- One comment block at the top of the header lists the emitted symbols (the interface), beside the "Responsibilities" index; the topic banners stay where they are.
- One unit test compares that list with the set the compiler emits (grep over lib/defk/compiler.ex), both ways: a symbol in the list that the compiler does not emit fails, and the reverse.
- Fix the line count in docs/agents/compiler-map.md.

No C changes. Gate: `mix ci`; PR per AGENTS.md.

comments.text: Branch defk-rt2.10/header-interface pushed (fcdb398f): interface and kernel lists at the top of the header, test/runtime_interface_test.exs (wildcard templates, owner's choice), map line count fixed; mix ci green. PR waits for the owner.

title: priv/defk_runtime.h lists the interface the compiler emits, checked by one test
